title: Notification regarding typing test and shorthand test for promotion to Stenographer Grade-I is rescheduled to 12th September,2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
No. HCMEST-32/1/2025-ESTT-II SECTiON-HCM/ /q & go : in continuation

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 3'd September, 2026
No. HCMEST-32/1/2025-ESTT-II SECTiON-HCM/ /q & go : in continuation
of this Registry’s earlier Notification of even number dated 4th August, 2026, it is
hereby notified to all concerned that the Computer Typing Test and Shorthand Test
for promotion to Stenographer Grade–I from amongst the eligible Stenographer
Grade–III, which was earlier scheduled to be held on 5th September, 2026 (Saturday)
at 2:00 p.m. at the High Court Complex, is hereby rescheduled to 12th September,
2026 (Saturday).
The remaining provisions of the earlier notification shall continue to remain
unchanged .
(JUDICIAL)REG
HIGH COURT OF WWPUR.
